title: True or false: scales mean reptile

scenes.headline: Its scales are made of hairs cemented together.
Babies ride on mum's back
scenes.body: Young are born with soft scales and are carried by the mother. (Tree pangolin, Ghana)

scenes.headline: Pangolins are mammals
scenes.body: Toothless, with a tongue up to 25 cm long for slurping termites and ants.

caption:
Scales can fool you.

The name pangolin comes from a Malay word meaning 'rolling over', because they curl into a ball when threatened. All eight species are now threatened.

Source: Britannica, Pangolin.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
